conbody.p: Motor tags are a free-form string key/value pair collection. They have the following characteristics:

ul.li: Tags can be used to categorize motors.
Tags can have an implicit hierarchy. The hierarchy can be used to group by categories and to generate a report or front-end display.
Tags are purely an organizational feature. They have no bearing on the motor analytics or data capture.
